character: Fast, flowing semi-street circuit around Albert Park Lake, resurfaced and widened for a more permanent-track feel. Mix of high-speed sweeps and a few technical braking zones.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Firm braking from the straight, late apex to set up Turn 3
corners.trap: Over-braking and getting passed on the inside at the first-lap pinch point

corners.name: Turn 6
corners.technique: Minimal lift, smooth steering, trust the grip through this quick section
corners.trap: Lifting or correcting mid-corner scrubs significant speed

corners.name: Turn 9-10
corners.technique: Carry momentum through both parts with smooth direction changes
corners.trap: Over-driving the first part compromises the second apex

corners.name: Turn 11
corners.type: medium-speed corner leading to the lake section
corners.technique: Late apex, prioritise a strong exit onto the following straight
corners.trap: Early apex kills exit speed onto the straight

corners.name: Turn 13
corners.technique: Hard braking, patient entry, clean exit onto the pit straight
corners.trap: Braking too late and running wide, losing drive onto the straight
